lines.t: I hear the echo of grace in the silence A heartbeat steady through my violence
Every broken word still finds its place In the mercy that rewrites my faith
I was chasing clouds that never stayed Painting dreams that slowly decayed
But every time I gave in to the grave You put me back where truth remains
When I stumble, you don't let go I see your light beneath, below
You are the fire that breaks my chains The calm within a storm of flames
When everything fades and dreams betray You're the light that never fades
You're the light that never fades
I've walked through valleys, cold and dry Where echoes tried to drown my cry
Yet in my weakness I was found Grace rose stronger than the sound
Fear was the prison, love was the key Opening doors that set me free
You are the fire that breaks my chains
The calm within a storm of flames
When everything fades and dreams betray
You're the light that never fades
Even a night takes all my sight
I know your breath ignites the fight
I've fallen down, yet still I rise
Held by hands that lift the skies
All the noise fades when you speak peace
My restless heart, finally released
I've wrestled out, I've faced the pain
I've called for hope and then this rain
Yet every tear became a flame
Revealing love I can't explain
You are the fire that breaks my chains
The calm within the storm of flames
When I forget your mercy stains
My light that never fades
I don't need sight to find the way
I feel it burn in my soul's display
Shadows fall, but can't invade The light that never fades
